correctness_confidence.basis: Every step of Theorems 3.1, 4.1, 5.1, and 6.1 checks out cleanly: the two-bin rational Cauchy-Schwarz identity, reweighted sub-probability extension for delta-NFCE, unscaled-simplex Hadamard bound, primal and Farkas-dual certificates for (Pm, Qm), and all b-ary tree and slack-exponent inequalities are exact.

rigor.basis: Proofs are complete, self-contained relative to Cheval et al. (2026), and carefully distinguish between what is formalized in Lean (algebraic identities, AM-GM/Cauchy-Schwarz bounds, primal/dual arithmetic, parameter inequalities) and what is proved in prose (game-tree semantics, Cramer/Hadamard, PPAD reductions).

novelty.basis: Replacing Shannon entropy and Pinsker's inequality with an elementary rational two-bin Cauchy-Schwarz partition yields strictly sharper bounds, enables inverse-polynomial delta-NFCE PPAD-completeness via AM-GM reweighting, and pairs a tightened Hadamard LP gap with an explicit {0,1}-bimatrix exponential necessity family.

significance.basis: Directly resolves four quantitative and structural open questions from Cheval et al. (2026): shrinking the PPAD-completeness gadget by 8x/64x, extending hardness to inverse-polynomial approximate NFCEs, proving 2^(-Omega(|S|)) LP precision is unavoidable even for {0,1} games, and characterizing subquadratic slack thresholds.

reproducibility.basis: All mathematical constructions, parameter choices, explicit bimatrix entries, and primal/Farkas-dual witnesses are given in full closed form in the manuscript, alongside explicit Lean theorem identifiers and SHA-256 verification manifests; under isolation, external repository files were not inspected directly.

summary: This paper establishes four sharp, transcendental-free refinements to the PPAD-completeness and support-bound framework of Cheval et al. (2026) for normal-form correlated equilibria (NFCE) in extensive-form games. First, a purely rational two-bin Cauchy-Schwarz bound replaces mutual information and Pinsker's inequality, yielding a sqrt(2)x sharper decoding constant near 1+ and an 8x/64x reduction in gadget size and support bound; a reweighted AM-GM extension then establishes PPAD-completeness for inverse-polynomial delta-NFCEs. Second, the paper halves the exponent in the uniform Hadamard LP gap (and replaces B with the leaf-product lcm) while constructing an explicit {0,1}-payoff bimatrix family proving 2^(-Omega(|S|)) minimum nonzero regret is unavoidable, certified by closed-form primal and Farkas-dual witnesses. Finally, it proves universal two-player totality at floor(|V|^2/4), exhibits an infinite failure family for floor(|V|^2/36), proves 1/36 is uniquely optimal over b-ary prefix-matching trees (attained iff b in {2,3}), and proves PPAD-completeness under any subquadratic additive slack gamma in (0,2] while pinpointing gamma = 0 as a matching-tree barrier.
strengths: Elementary two-bin rational Cauchy-Schwarz argument over Q that strictly beats Pinsker's inequality on (1, 3.51286...) and shrinks Cheval et al.'s gadget parameter m by 8x and kappa_d by 64x.
Clean reweighted sub-probability Cauchy-Schwarz and AM-GM extension proving PPAD-completeness for inverse-polynomial delta-NFCEs at Theta(|V|^(-8/3)) and Theta(|V|^(-5/2)).

Sharp LP gap improvement (halved exponent and leaf-product lcm) paired with an explicit {0,1}-payoff bimatrix family (Pm, Qm) having closed-form primal and Farkas-dual certificates for exact regret (2^(m+5) - 14m - 30)^(-1).

Complete characterization of node-based totality (floor(|V|^2/4)), infinite failure of floor(|V|^2/36), unique 1/36 optimality at b in {2,3}, and PPAD-completeness for all subquadratic slack exponents gamma in (0,2].
Transparent delineation of what is machine-checked in constructive Lean 4 vs. proved in prose.
weaknesses: Builds directly on the public-coin prefix-matching gadget of Cheval et al. (2026) rather than introducing a new reduction architecture, leaving the constant multiplicative slack regime (gamma = 0) and unrestricted polynomial support bounds open.

In Theorem 4.1(2), the complexity statement specifies delta = Theta(|V|^(-8/3)) and Theta(|V|^(-5/2)) via reduction-specific formulas in r without explicitly formalizing the functional dependence delta(|V|) for arbitrary instances.

In Theorem 6.1(4), polynomial-time verification of the floor bounds for PPAD membership implicitly assumes C and gamma are rational or efficiently computable constants, and the external Lean/Python verification artifacts could not be audited under PDF-only isolation.
strong_novelty_candidates: Transcendental-free two-bin rational Cauchy-Schwarz decoding bound TV(mu, mu1 x mu2)^2 <= (1/4)(kappa/m^2 - 1) and its reweighted sub-probability extension for delta-NFCE.
Explicit {0,1}-payoff bimatrix family (Pm, Qm) with closed-form primal and Farkas-dual proof of exact exponentially small nonzero LP regret (2^(m+5) - 14m - 30)^(-1).

Uniqueness proof that 1/36 is optimal across all uniform b-ary prefix-matching trees iff b in {2,3} via (b^2+b)/(b-1) - 6 = (b-2)(b-3)/(b-1), plus subquadratic-slack PPAD-completeness down to the gamma = 0 barrier.
